tasks.title: Mirror the wire in types and mint a deterministic result key
tasks.dod: The same (testId, retry) yields the same key across two independent calls; a key over 200 chars falls back to a deterministic hash.

tasks.title: HTTP client: classify every response, retry only what retrying can fix
tasks.dod: Network, 429, 5xx, 401, 409 and 400 each have a test; a 429 waits exactly its Retry-After; the token appears in no log line.

tasks.title: Append unsent batches to a JSONL fallback
tasks.dod: A process killed mid-write leaves the earlier lines valid; the token is never in the file.

tasks.title: Run session: start or join, resolve once, buffer, flush, finish
tasks.dod: Four sessions sharing an externalKey use one runId; resolve is called once per run, never per test; an unresolved result is not sent; no process exit handler is registered.

tasks.title: The ReporterV2 adapter, thin by construction
